intent: Three new weird-but-cute character concepts matching the existing oneBeat cast.

concepts.name: 磁带小怪
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: new original playable walking character concept for the oneBeat cast.
Input roles: Images 1–3 are authoritative STYLE references (existing teapot, striped walking kid, purple-haired walking girl). They are NOT edit targets. Create a genuinely new character, not one of those people with a different hat.
Style/medium: match their hand-drawn comic animation vocabulary: organic confident variable-width black ink silhouette, finer expressive interior lines, sparse directional hatching, saturated but controlled flat colors with selective cel shadow planes, tangible cloth folds and chunky footwear. Enough personality and line detail to sit beside this cast. Not minimalist stick figures, sterile vector icons, soft toy 3D, painterly rendering, glossy mascot stickers or super-deformed baby chibi.
Personality: slightly odd, offbeat and lovable, with subtly asymmetrical features and a readable quirky silhouette; mildly deadpan charm rather than huge sparkling anime eyes or a wide commercial grin. Cute through unusual construction and posture, not through excessive decoration.
Composition: exactly ONE complete full-body character in a natural walking step toward screen-right, near-profile/slight three-quarter side view. STRICTLY LEVEL eye-height camera with horizontal horizon and minimal foreshortening, neither looking down nor looking up. Keep the body, face and footwear visible and legible. Square canvas with generous margins, no cropping. Pose should be feasible to animate later.
Backdrop/output: genuinely transparent PNG alpha background. Subtle small semitransparent charcoal contact shadow beneath the planted sole, lighter ground shadow beneath the lifted foot. No scenery, floor strip, colored background, baked checkerboard, frame, text, lettering, logos, watermark, concept sheet or extra characters.

Subject concept: an anthropomorphic old audio cassette with a wide horizontal cassette-shaped head, warm cream casing and a small coral-red panel. The two round tape reels are its actual eyes: one half-lidded, one slightly wide and curious, looking forward. A loose ribbon of dark magnetic tape slips out and curls over one corner like an unruly cowlick, another short ribbon trails softly like a scarf; these are integrated tape, not extra black limbs. Tiny crooked lower mouth cutout. Small plum-purple boxy work jacket with rolled sleeves, pale denim shorts, warm gray short limbs and off-white high-top canvas sneakers with coral toes. Head occupies about one third of character height, not an enormous mascot head. Walking casually with hands tucked in jacket pockets, one sneaker swinging forward. Distinctively wide head over a narrower lanky body, relaxed slightly slouchy attitude. Keep cassette construction simple, no brands, no written tape labels, no headphones or robot machinery.

Subject concept: a softly wobbling anthropomorphic mail drop box made of peach-coral jelly. A tall round-topped mailbox silhouette forms the entire head-and-torso, with a slightly sagging translucent lilac lower edge and two or three simple ivory envelope shapes visible inside its belly (no writing). Two small unequal dark oval eyes just above a horizontal mail-slot mouth, giving it a bashful deadpan expression. A modest cream metallic lip outlines the mouth slot, an envelope corner sticks gently out of the slot like a shy tongue. Short soft lilac arms, one hand resting protectively over the belly and the other swinging, two short sturdy legs and oversized navy canvas sneakers with ivory soles and orange laces. The postbox itself is the creature, NOT a person wearing a mailbox costume, and NOT a head on a hoodie body. A small simple side mail-collection door detail, no lettering. Mid-step slightly wobbly gait, upper body leans a little forward; cute weight and softness, but drawn using ink and flat cel shading, not shiny jelly 3D. Distinctive tall rounded body and compact limbs.

Subject concept: a grumpy-cute mushroom creature apparently growing out of a pair of huge rainboots. Broad asymmetrical dusty-violet mushroom cap with three large irregular warm ivory patches, one edge droops over an eye like an oversized fringe. A thick short ivory mushroom stalk forms its face and body; one visible black oval eye and a second partially hidden sleepy eye, a tiny neutral mouth, no nose. It wears a short rust-orange rain cape with a chunky ivory fastening, sleeves wide enough for two small cream hands, no human hair. Two enormous deep blue rubber rainboots with ivory rim piping and a little earth-brown hatch wear near the soles, the soft stalk divides into two short legs disappearing into the boots. Tiny cream root-tassels peek from one boot rim, no flowers or forest scenery. Walking with one heavy boot firmly planted and the other taking an exaggerated careful short step, one hand lifting the drooping cap edge slightly. Dominant broad cap/oversized boots silhouette, compact middle, a quiet stubborn explorer rather than a sugary garden fairy. Not a realistic mushroom, not a human in a mushroom hat, no parasol.
